grant_storage.holds: JSON bundle: access_token, refresh_token, token_type, expires_at, obtained_at, scope, refresh_expires_at
grant_storage.also: config secrets oauth.microsoft.client_id/tenant_id, oauth.google.client_id/client_secret are shared app-level, not per-grant

existing_delete_or_forget.calls: gates.tokens.delete_tokens() (src/gates/tokens.py:154), which calls secrets_port.delete() and swallows KeyError (idempotent)
existing_delete_or_forget.cli_exposure: none seen in connect.py main(); disconnect only exported via gates/__init__.py per docs/connect.md, no CLI subcommand in these files

result.account_source: nothing stored: TokenBundle has no id_token, no userinfo/profile fields, no email/name/oid claim anywhere in tokens.py or oauth_http.py; oauth_http.py never requests/reads an id_token or calls a userinfo endpoint; person identity comes only from the caller-supplied 'person' string (default 'braden'), not from provider data
result.provider_revoke: none present: oauth_http.py has only build_authorize_url, exchange_code, refresh_access_token(_async), run_connection_test — no call to Google's revoke endpoint or Microsoft's logout/revoke; disconnect() only deletes the local secret, tokens are not invalidated at the provider
risks: disconnect has no revoke call, so provider-side grant persists after local delete — must be documented or added
no stored account email/name means UI can't confirm 'who is connected' without adding an id_token/userinfo read, which changes scopes/claims stored
delete_tokens swallows KeyError silently — a disconnect on an already-disconnected connector reports success with no distinguishing signal, fine for idempotency but worth noting in UI copy
no audit event logged for disconnect (connect/refresh/test_connection all call audit.append_event; disconnect() at connect.py:396 does not)
